cicids2017.evidence_rationale: Maintains 1.0000 F1 across all temporal day-based splits with sub-microsecond inference throughput.

cicids2018.evidence_rationale: Generalizes across multi-day attack evolutions with 0.0000 FPR and high training throughput.

cicddos2019.evidence_rationale: CatBoost provides superior out-of-distribution boundary preservation when evaluating unseen reflection and amplification protocols.

unsw.evidence_rationale: High feature stability on packet headers and flow payload ratios with rapid real-time scoring latency.

malwarebazaar.evidence_rationale: Random Forest provides variance-reduction resistance against polymorphic signature drift across temporal submission windows.

overall_netragraph_architecture.architectural_summary: NetraGraph benefits from a specialized ensemble routing approach: deploying CatBoost for protocol-level DDoS defenses, Random Forest for malware family classification, and XGBoost/LightGBM for high-throughput live network perimeter monitoring.
